checks.name: reference_consistency

checks.method: Resolved every evidence reference (scan_id, snapshot ordinal, finding_id) against the stored snapshots in canonical stored order, and compared each snapshot's recorded scan_id and finding_id with the run identity and the reconstructed record. Occurrences sharing a finding_id are not deduplicated.
checks.statement: All 1 evidence reference(s) resolve to exactly one stored snapshot occurrence of run synthetic-partial-001.
limitations: Reference consistency is an identity check over stored records. It is not a content-integrity check and does not re-hash stored evidence.

checks.name: scan_time_basis

checks.method: Parsed the run's recorded scan_time as an ISO-8601 timestamp. Time-based derivations use that recorded time; no current-clock value is substituted when it is missing or unreadable.
checks.statement: The run recorded scan time 2025-11-04T09:30:00+00:00, which is the basis for every time-based derivation in this view.
limitations: The recorded scan time is the collecting host's clock reading. It is not independently attested or externally timestamped.

limitations: Only scope the scanners recorded is considered. Scope that was never requested, and scope no scanner can enumerate, is outside this check.
